title: About HornSphere Consulting
description: About HornSphere Consulting, a Mogadishu-based company focused on research, capacity development and international student recruitment.
html:
About HornSphere

Built around expertise.

HornSphere is a Mogadishu-based consulting company delivering research-led advisory, research capacity development and international student recruitment, with a regional focus on Somalia, the Horn of Africa and wider East Africa.

Who we are

One company. Three principal services.

We work with institutions, professionals, students and universities. Each engagement begins with the need, then brings the right people and process around it.

Our consulting model lets clients access specialist expertise while HornSphere remains responsible for scoping, delivery and the final result.

2025Established in Mogadishu
3Principal service areas
6Priority advisory sectors
200+Students supported in 12 months
Vision, mission & values

A clear purpose behind every assignment.

01 / Our vision

Stronger institutions. Wider opportunity.

To build a regionally respected consulting company that strengthens institutions, expands knowledge and connects people and organisations to opportunities through evidence, expertise and meaningful partnerships.

02 / Our mission

Practical work with lasting value.

To deliver evidence-based consulting, research capacity development and international student recruitment that help institutions, organisations and individuals make stronger decisions, develop capability and achieve sustainable outcomes.

Core values

Six standards that guide the work.

Integrity, evidence, confidentiality, quality assurance and professional partnership shape how we work with clients and collaborators.

  1. 01

    Integrity

    Communicate capabilities, evidence, findings and commitments accurately.

  2. 02

    Evidence

    Use research and analysis when a decision needs a credible evidence base.

  3. 03

    Professional excellence

    Deliver work fit for its intended institutional or professional use.

  4. 04

    Accountability

    Keep clear responsibility for scope, coordination, quality and delivery.

  5. 05

    Partnership

    Work collaboratively with clients, institutions and professional partners.

  6. 06

    Capability development

    Strengthen people's and institutions' knowledge and skills where relevant.

Our work

Expertise that meets the assignment.

travel_exploreService 01

Research & advisory

Applied research, feasibility, evaluation, spatial analysis and technical advice across six priority sectors.

Explore service arrow_forward
psychology_altService 02

Capacity development

Training for institutions, professionals and postgraduate researchers to design, conduct and apply research.

Explore service arrow_forward
publicService 03

International student recruitment

Study guidance for students and responsible recruitment support for universities, with Malaysia as the principal market.

Explore service arrow_forward
Leadership & delivery

One accountable partner. Expertise matched to the assignment.

HornSphere combines a lean core management team with researchers, academics, advisers and technical specialists selected for each assignment. We retain responsibility for the client relationship, scope, coordination, quality and final delivery.

Head office & regional focus Hodan District, Mogadishu, Somalia

Our physical office is in Mogadishu. Somalia, the Horn of Africa and wider East Africa form the main geographic context of our work, with education-sector and student-support networks connected to Malaysia.

AO
Managing Director

Adam Osman

Leads institutional engagement and HornSphere's corporate direction.

Specialist delivery network

Teams are assembled around sector expertise, research methods, technical requirements, professional qualifications and project complexity.

Responsible practice

HornSphere has not yet formalised a separate large-scale CSR programme. Its work supports research capability, education access, skills transfer and responsible professional practice.

Experience

Selected assignments.

Representative work. Some client engagements are confidential and shown in summary form.

Public sector

Feasibility assessment of a national export-management system: workflow mapping, institutional constraints and a phased roadmap.

Environment
